title: UPF and SMF crash

labels.name: Housekeeping:ToClose
labels.description: Issues reviewed and closed. Old requests, issues which are not bug, feature or documentation request

body:
Hi,

I running open5gs version 2.5.6 in kubernet 

1. run open5gs-upfd
2. run open5gs-smfd
3. crash open5gs-upfd
4. crash open5gs-smfd

# upf.yaml
```
logger:
    file: /var/log/open5gs/upf.log

#  <PFCP Server>
upf:
  pfcp:
    - dev eth0
  gtpu:
    - dev eth0
  subnet:
    - addr: 10.45.0.1/16
      dev: ogstun
      dnn: internet
    - addr: 2001:db8:cafe::1/48

#

```
